issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Empacer
products.tagline: The voice-first assistant for small business owners
products.summaryZh: 为小企业主打造的语音优先助手
products.descriptionZh: 大多数小企业主在使用AI工具时都面临同一个问题：他们没有时间在每次对话中重新解释自己的业务。Empacer的设计正是为了跳过这一环节。设置时只需回答三个问题，之后口述请求即可转化为现成的方案和已完成的工作：客户回复、社交媒体帖子、发票等。未经所有者批准，不会发送任何内容。
products.description: Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

products.name: Scape
products.tagline: An intelligent email inbox that works for you
products.summaryZh: 一个为你效力的智能邮件收件箱
products.descriptionZh: 想象一下，打开收件箱时所有邮件都已整理妥当，回复也已准备好供你审阅。Scape 是一款智能电子邮件客户端，能对邮件进行优先级排序、准备结合上下文的草稿，并帮助跟踪对话和后续跟进。它理解你在邮件、会议、日历和附件中的工作，让你减少管理沟通的时间，把更多时间用于推进工作。
products.description: Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward.

products.name: Floot in ChatGPT
products.tagline: Build and publish real apps without leaving ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 无需离开ChatGPT即可构建并发布真实应用
products.descriptionZh: Floot 现已成为 ChatGPT 侧边栏中的原生应用。描述你的需求，即可在聊天内的实时预览中观看它构建，并通过真实链接发布。数据库、登录和托管均已内置，AI 运行在你的 ChatGPT 套餐上。
products.description: Floot is now a native app in your ChatGPT sidebar. Describe what you want, watch it build in a live preview inside the chat, and publish it with a real link. Database, logins and hosting are built in, and the AI runs on your ChatGPT plan.

products.name: Notch Metrics
products.tagline: Use claude code to build analytics widgets for your notch
products.summaryZh: 使用 Claude Code 为你的 notch 构建分析小组件
products.descriptionZh: 来自 Stripe、Polar、Paddle、Dodo Payments 等的收入、MRR 和订阅用户数，显示在 MacBook 刘海区域。
products.description: Revenue, MRR and subscribers from Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Dodo Payments and more, in the MacBook notch.

products.name: Gologin Cloud Browser
products.tagline: Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理和复杂网站的云浏览器
products.descriptionZh: Gologin Cloud Browser 为 AI 代理和爬虫提供保持登录状态的真实 Chromium 浏览器。持久会话可跨运行保留，因此无需重新认证，也不会丢失状态。内置隐身和反机器人保护，并在 150 多个国家/地区提供代理。完全无服务器，可扩展至数千个浏览器，并通过 WebSocket 与 Playwright 和 Puppeteer 配合使用。由 GoLogin 团队打造：7 年专业经验、SOC 2 Type II、99.9% SLA。套餐每月 4.50 美元起。
products.description: Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo.

products.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
products.tagline: Google's next frontier model
products.summaryZh: 谷歌的下一代前沿模型
products.descriptionZh: Gemini 4 Carbon是我们最强的模型，具备最先进的网络安全和长程能力。
products.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

products.name: TopAgent
products.tagline: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent
products.summaryZh: 用AI智能体提升B2B活动出席率
products.descriptionZh: 用短信邀请和相关的后续跟进，为你的下一场B2B会议、峰会或研讨会填满席位。将已选择接收信息的受众、活动详情、注册链接和截止日期交给TopAgent。它会准备活动、监控送达、点击和回复，并带着可供你审批的后续跟进内容返回。
products.description: Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

products.name: Radar
products.tagline: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.
products.summaryZh: 你不需要一个AI SRE。给你的智能体配上Radar。
products.descriptionZh: 你的 agent 了解 Kubernetes，却不了解你的集群。开源工具 Radar 通过 MCP 为它提供上下文：按优先级排序的问题、变更时间线、日志和负责人，一屏尽览。新增功能：在故障工作负载上点击 Investigate。Claude Code、Codex 或 Cursor 会以只读方式找出根因，并为每项结论提供证据。在我们对六款工具、50 个真实故障的基准测试中，Radar 找出的根因最多。Radar Cloud 会调查每一条告警，并将发现发布到 Slack。
products.description: Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

products.name: Viggle JST-2
products.tagline: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model
products.summaryZh: JST-2：单一模型生成三维场景、角色与动作
products.descriptionZh: JST-2 是 Viggle 的物理原生世界基础模型，可在同一个共享世界中生成 3D 场景、角色和全身动作。场景生成约需一秒，角色可从单张图像或文本生成并内置动作，动作则可由文本或视频驱动。可在 PINOC 浏览器应用中免费试用，也可通过 API 或 MCP 与 Claude Code 等智能体配合使用。基准测试为 Viggle 自行开展的盲测人工评估。
products.description: JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

products.name: IFTTT.ai
products.tagline: The easiest way to automate anything
products.summaryZh: 最简便的自动化任何事的方法
products.descriptionZh: IFTTT 现已更名为 IFTTT.ai，所有套餐均包含核心功能及全部 1000 多项服务，涵盖多操作、过滤器、查询和 Webhooks。定价基于信用点数，你可以免费创建无限个 Applet。AI 功能也升级了。AI Agent 可监控网页的价格变动或新上架信息，AI Action assist 根据触发器编写每个操作，AI 查询则运行在更优的模型上。或者，在 IFTTT Chat 中描述自动化流程，它便会为你构建 Applet。
products.description: IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

products.name: Intrascope 2.0
products.tagline: New AI agent, 1,650+ apps, Skills and smart model routing
products.summaryZh: 全新AI智能体，支持1,650+应用、技能与智能模型路由
products.descriptionZh: 有何不同：ChatGPT和Claude将你锁定在单一供应商。Intrascope 2.0为你的团队提供120多种模型（GPT-6、Claude、Gemini、Grok、Qwen），外加一个可在Gmail、Slack、Drive和Notion等1,650多个应用中工作的AI代理。公司始终保持控制权：管理员可审批应用和模型，按团队、项目和个人设置预算，并查看每一笔token和费用。2.0新增：代理、连接器、Skills、自动路由、全面重新设计。为企业提供私有化和本地部署。
products.description: What's different: ChatGPT and Claude lock you into one vendor. Intrascope 2.0 gives your team 120+ models (GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen) plus an AI agent that works in 1,650+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Drive and Notion. The company stays in control: admins approve apps and models, set budgets per team, project and person, and see every token and dollar. New in 2.0: agent, connectors, Skills, Auto routing, full redesign. Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise.

products.name: Confetti
products.tagline: Easiest way to build hardware gadgets using plain English
products.summaryZh: 用通俗英语构建硬件小工具的最简单方法
products.descriptionZh: 过去做硬件需要花几周时间学习CAD、采购兼容零件并编写固件。有了Confetti，一切从对话开始。你可以创建和编辑设计、查找组件，并将打印好的零件直接订购到家门口。从零开始，或基于社区项目进行混编，打造属于你自己的作品。
products.description: Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it starts with a conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

products.name: Voxel51 Multimodal
products.tagline: Better data. Smarter robots. Repeat.
products.summaryZh: 更好的数据。更智能的机器人。周而复始。
products.descriptionZh: 现实世界是混乱的。机器人会遇到意外情况，并以你从未预料到的方式行动。但每一次失败都是教会机器人新东西的机会。难的是什么呢？要从数小时的视频和传感器数据中筛选，找出机器人失败的原因。Voxel51 是一个端到端多模态数据平台，可加速机器人学习。找到关键的失败案例，理解其发生原因，并填补训练数据中的空白，从而更快地改进模型。免费试用 Voxel51。
products.description: The real world is messy. Robots encounter unexpected situations and behave in ways you never anticipated. But every failure is a chance to teach your robot something new. The hard part? Sifting through hours of video and sensor data to figure out why your robot failed. Voxel51 is an end-to-end multimodal data platform that accelerates robot learning. Find the failures that matter, understand why they happened, and fill gaps in your training data to improve models faster. Try Voxel51 for free.

products.name: JIMMY
products.tagline: JIMMY is an AI agent that runs on your PC
products.summaryZh: JIMMY 是一款在你的电脑上运行的 AI 代理
products.descriptionZh: JIMMY 在你的 Windows 电脑上运行，并监听你的 WhatsApp 自我聊天。发送“把 Downloads 里的简历发给 Rahul”或“截图”，它就会执行任务，在发送任何内容前先询问，并回复。包含定时任务、自定义命令、/stop 和撤销日志。
products.description: JIMMY runs on your Windows PC and listens to your WhatsApp self-chat. Text "send the resume in Downloads to Rahul" or "screenshot" and it does the task, asks before sending anything, and replies. Scheduled tasks, custom commands, /stop and an undo log included.

products.name: Suno MCP
products.tagline: The music layerfor your AI stack
products.summaryZh: 为你的AI技术栈打造的音乐层
products.descriptionZh: MCP 代表 Model Context Protocol，是一种开放标准，让 AI 助手能够与其他应用协同工作。Suno MCP 将你的 Suno 账户连接到你已在使用的 AI 助手，例如 ChatGPT 和 Claude。连接后，你可以直接在正在进行的对话中，让助手创作歌曲、延长歌曲、翻唱歌曲等！你的助手可以利用你们已经讨论过的所有内容（歌词、项目、视频计划），因此你无需重新解释你的想法。
products.description: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI assistants work with other apps. The Suno MCP connects your Suno account to the AI assistants you already use, like ChatGPT and Claude. Once it’s connected, you can ask your assistant to make a song, extend it, cover it, and more, right in the conversation you’re already having! Your assistant can use everything you’ve already discussed (lyrics, a project, a video plan) so you don’t have to re-explain your idea.

products.name: Smart Jelly
products.tagline: Your everyday AI tools and memory in one Mac app.
products.summaryZh: 你日常使用的 AI 工具和记忆功能，都集成在一个 Mac 应用里。
products.descriptionZh: 一款应用集听写、实时会议辅助、会前笔记、笔记助手、追踪未闭环事项与智能体于一体，全部共享同一份关于你的记忆。无需为五个各自从零开始的AI工具付费。每项功能都了解你的工作，并随着使用越来越智能。
products.description: One app for dictation, live meeting help, Pre meeting notes, Notetaker, Track open loops and agents, all sharing one memory of you. No need to pay for five AI tools that each start from zero. Every feature knows your work and gets smarter as you use it.

products.name: AutoShelf 2.6
products.tagline: Automate any folder on your Mac with if-this-then-that rules
products.summaryZh: 用“如果这样则那样”的规则自动化 Mac 上的任意文件夹
products.descriptionZh: AutoShelf 是一款 Mac 应用，可根据你一次性设定的规则，自动归档、重命名、添加标签、转换并整理“下载”和“桌面”等文件夹中的新文件。新增功能：按 %kind% 和 %date% 等标记构建子文件夹并进行分类、解压缩、Finder 颜色标签，以及覆盖全部或选定子文件夹的规则。免费版支持 1 条规则；一次性支付 19.99 美元可解锁无限规则（11 月 25 日起为 29.99 美元）。需要 macOS 14 Sonoma 或更高版本。
products.description: AutoShelf is a Mac app that automatically files, renames, tags, converts, and sorts new files in folders like Downloads and Desktop, based on rules you set once. New: sort into subfolders built from tokens like %kind% and %date%, unarchive, Finder color labels, and rules that cover all or selected subfolders. Free with 1 rule, or $19.99 one-time for unlimited rules ($29.99 from Nov 25). Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

products.name: MAO
products.tagline: Team up Claude Code, Codex and Grok on one canvas
products.summaryZh: 在同一个画布上协同使用 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok
products.descriptionZh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 Grok 放在同一画布上，让它们像团队一样协作。连接两个智能体，它们会交流、分派任务并回传结果，由你来主导。原生支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，使用 Rust 构建。7 天免费试用，无需信用卡。之后一次性支付 20 美元。
products.description: Put Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Grok on one canvas and let them work as a team. Wire two agents and they talk, delegate and hand back results while you lead. Native on macOS, Linux and Windows, built in Rust. 7-day free trial, no card. Then $20, once.

products.name: StoreLocale
products.tagline: Translate app UI in App Store & Google Play screenshots
products.summaryZh: 翻译 App Store 和 Google Play 截图中的应用界面
products.descriptionZh: 本地化 App Store 和 Google Play 截图中的界面。StoreLocale 可检测文本，将其翻译成 32 种语言，并在保持布局不变的情况下就地重绘。在编辑器中查看结果，然后按商店、语言和尺寸分组导出 PNG。编辑器免费；使用你自己的 Gemini 或 OpenRouter API 密钥，或购买一次性积分用于 AI 图像生成。
products.description: Localize the UI inside App Store and Google Play screenshots. StoreLocale detects text, translates it into 32 languages, and repaints it in place while keeping the layout intact. Review results in the editor, then export PNGs grouped by store, language, and size. The editor is free; use your own Gemini or OpenRouter API key, or buy one-time credits for AI image generation.

products.name: Opus 5.5 Video Generator
products.tagline: Turn a text prompt into a 1080p motion-graphics MP4
products.summaryZh: 将文本提示转换为1080p动态图形MP4
products.descriptionZh: 描述一段视频，Claude Opus 5.5 会为其制作分镜、将动画编写为代码并检查自己的预览帧，然后我们以 1080p、30 fps 渲染每一帧为带音乐的 MP4。专为发布视频、讲解视频、动态字体、动画图表和社交广告打造，其中文字、数字和品牌颜色必须保持精确。时长 15 到 60 秒，支持 16:9、9:16 或 1:1，无需安装或 API 密钥，失败的视频可退款。
products.description: Describe a video and Claude Opus 5.5 storyboards it, writes the animation as code and checks its own preview frames, then we render every frame to a 1080p, 30 fps MP4 with music. Built for launch videos, explainers, kinetic typography, animated charts and social ads where text, numbers and brand colors must stay exact. 15 to 60 seconds, 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, no install or API key, and failed videos are refunded.
